limitations: Cross-project and OS text clipboard workflows remain missing; property paste still requires matching FPS.
General multibus compound processing/audibility and compositing dependencies retain safety restrictions; this change admits one unchanged audio bus with multiple video tracks.
The audio comparison is one native 80 ms PCM fragment at frame zero, not continuous playback, physical audio or hardware GPU qualification.
OTIO import still creates a new project rather than merging into the current project; its native media probing worker isolation remains a follow-up.
Nested OTIO export is unsupported by the original native exporter and remains explicitly refused. External-editor/font-environment interoperability is not established.
The first finite API script assumed every OTIO Parameter ID had a Parameter Value; the native HTML title blob does not. Only that fixture parser was corrected before the passing run.
